CYP2D6.note: CYP2D6 has a highly homologous pseudogene (CYP2D7) nearby and complex structural variation. This padded gene-body extraction is sufficient for initial inspection; PharmCAT's own VCF preprocessing step (a later milestone) has its own recommended region/handling for CYP2D6 and may require re-extraction.

notes: Coordinates are the canonical gene span reported by NCBI Gene (GRCh38.p14 annotation), not guessed.

extraction_region adds a symmetric 5000 bp flank around the gene body to capture nearby regulatory/promoter variants; this is a deliberate, documented choice, not an authoritative 'PGx region' definition.
raw/ files (data/raw/1kGP_chr*_*_region.vcf.gz) were pulled directly from the official source using extraction_region via a remote bcftools query -- no full chromosome file was downloaded.

processed/ files (data/processed/cyp2c19.vcf.gz, cyp2d6.vcf.gz) are produced by locally re-slicing the raw files down to the exact gene_start-gene_end boundary (no padding), giving a clean canonical-gene-only VCF.
